title: The Veil of the Weeping Wood
author: E. M. Voss
blurb: Zephyrine Joubert, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
